requirements.text: The app must provide real-time transaction notifications that ensure sensitive data is encrypted, comply with PSD2's Strong Customer Authentication, avoid unnecessary exposure of personal data, and require customer consent.
The app must allow customers to freeze and unfreeze their cards, with strict verification of user identity to maintain compliance with security standards.
All new features must be designed and implemented in full compliance with PSD2, GDPR, and Central Bank consumer protection rules.
Any new functionalities must integrate smoothly with the existing core banking infrastructure without requiring significant modifications.
A thorough assessment of existing systems is necessary to ensure they can support new functionalities while remaining compliant with the relevant regulations.
